name: Cecil
source: The daughter of the Glasse family and Kain’s younger sister. She is intelligent but a bit absent-minded, which endears her to others. Traumatized by past events, she is extremely afraid of cats, even fearing Puchiko in her cat-eared hat. She possesses great power but usually suppresses it. She is very close friends with Wendy.
